decisions.reason: Choosing 286R as the document designation does not change any supplied dates or their application to date fields.
The document designation does not change the supplied $16,200 allocation or the rule for populating the allocated-budget field.
The designation decision leaves both contract IDs not provided; it does not clearly direct that 286R be entered as a contract ID.
Selecting the 286R designation does not alter the personnel calculation formula, session counts, rates, or budget-gap treatment.
The approved non-personnel allocation rule is independent of whether the document is designated 286R or 201.
The designation decision does not change the seven-week Annex B requirement.
The source decision does not change any service weekdays or session time slots.
The document designation does not affect the requirement to sign the subcontractor section.
Selecting 286R for the other site's document does not alter the established equivalence between NCA and NH.
